title: Che susurro, che strepito
subtitle: Don Alfonso, Dorabella, Fiordiligi, Despina, Ferrando and Guglielmo: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 11, recitative after No. 13
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (perchè, si possente without its accent, Madame). Dorabella's last line, Sorella, che facciamo?, runs on into No. 14, which begins on the same page: this piece ends on fac-.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 109–112, the recitative between No. 13 and No. 14 (43 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 109–110 and 111–112), then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (one error found and corrected: the piano's E flats on the fourth beat of bar 33). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 2, 15, 17, 21, 22, 25, 28 and 34), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. Bars 28 (Guglielmo) and 31 (Ferrando) are each printed an eighth too long; Guglielmo's first note and Ferrando's second C are written as eighths (which note the engraver got wrong cannot be proved). The printed “Allegretto” (bar 11) and “sempre a tempo colla parte” (bar 32) are kept as words. Playback tempo: Free, as recitative is sung: played here at a speaking pace, ♩ = 82, from the median of six recordings (Böhm, Haitink, Solti, Nézet-Séguin, Currentzis, Marriner; most of their tracks run on into “Temerari”, so this recitative's share was taken in proportion; about 2 minutes).

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
